foundation: C14: Loading, empty, error and restricted states
identity: Blue-teal with warm copper and cool neutral support.
domain_style: Compact blue-teal catalogue operations with cool-neutral loading rows, restrained copper context and clearly different rejected versus suspended account treatments.

panels.label: Loading
panels.specimen: Compact catalogue skeleton rows with neutral square thumbnails and two text bars. Heading "Loading catalogue". Helper "Keep existing rows during refresh". Small note "One loading announcement; reduced-motion static". No product counts or stock numbers.

panels.label: Empty
panels.specimen: Catalogue box outline. Title "No products yet". Body "Create your first catalogue item." Primary "Add product". Separate thin inset labelled Filtered catalogue: "No matching products" with text action "Clear filters". Note "Keep search and sort". These are independent illustrative cases.

panels.label: Error
panels.specimen: Compact error block title "Catalogue unavailable". Body "We couldn’t load your products. Try again." Filled blue-teal button "Retry". Copper helper "Retry loading; keep catalogue controls". No raw server error, fake stock or publish action.

panels.label: Restricted
panels.specimen: Two separately labelled small cases. Rejected: title "Application not approved", helper "Reopen the application as a draft", button "Fix and resubmit". Divider. Suspended: title "Seller account suspended", helper "Contact support to resolve access", actions "Contact support" and "Sign out". No retry or self-reactivate control for suspension. No automatic approval or immediate-resubmit success.

state_contract: Evaluate authentication/authorization and requested scope before interpreting data as empty; preserve security boundaries.
First load with no data gets labelled skeleton/progress, not fake records, prices, amounts, percentages or wait-time estimates.
Refresh retains safe available content with a visible progress/error indicator. Cached or failed-refresh records must be labelled last-known.
True empty requires a successful applicable read; filtered no-match, bounded loaded-prefix no-match and failed reads are distinct.
Permission errors are not ordinary recoverable network errors. Offer supported sign-in/support/navigation rather than blind retry or self-unlock.
Retry is scoped to the failed recoverable read, preserves controls, ignores duplicate taps while pending and never replays uncertain mutations.
Restricted actions depend on actual reason/status and server authority. Reopen/edit/resubmit only where supported; submission is not approval.
Unavailable balances, stock and counts stay unavailable/unknown; errors never imply zero, deletion, settlement or success.
Safe localized copy says what is unavailable and a meaningful next step; no raw exceptions, internal document paths or sensitive record details.
Reuse Seller/Delivery/SA/shared state families; separate app theme adapters and semantics rather than introducing duplicate components.
Loading uses one bounded announcement; icons have text explanations. Maintain focus and 48px targets, static skeletons for reduced motion. These are target requirements, not certification.
Four board panels are isolated illustrative scenarios, not simultaneous app states or real-account screenshots. All C14 boards remain provisional.
